Gold and Silver Prices Plummet in Indian Markets

Gold and silver prices experienced a significant drop in Indian markets. Silver fell by over ₹5,000 per kilogram, and gold decreased by more than ₹1,700 per 10 grams. One report noted silver's price dropping from ₹4 lakh to ₹2.13 lakh, with gold also falling by ₹35,000.
